answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. By the vine of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The lotus holds work receipts rather than names, so the canyon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, released only after three unrelated confirmations, no identity may audit its own recruit.
